poc_details: Objective: validate Dedicated capacity can meet throughput guarantees and latency SLOs for mixed chat + reranking workload
Representative workload: 60% short-chat (avg 64 tokens), 30% mid-chat (avg 256 tokens), 10% reranking batches (128 items)
Throughput targets: sustained 2,500 req/minute (≈41.6 req/s), burst 5,000 req/minute for 10 minutes
Latency SLOs: p50 < 80ms (chat short), p95 < 220ms (chat short), p99 < 500ms; reranking batch p95 < 1.2s
Reserved GPU plan: recommend starting with 4xA100-equivalent nodes (N = 4) with 2x burst capacity; sizing scenarios included in Drive
Batching strategy: automatic batching with max latency budget 20ms, target batch size tuned per seq len
KV caching: prefix caching of common prompts, warmup script will pre-populate caches before soak test
Soak test: 48 hours at 60-70% target utilization to observe degradataion patterns and memory leak risks
Failure modes: node replacement + fallback to hosted variant; validate model switch under load
Success criteria: sustained throughput within ±10% of target without p95 breaches >2% of requests; no unplanned restarts; documented cost per 1M tokens
